source_contract: hash-chained JSONL fault ledgers plus versioned human fault books
identity_rule: stable fault_id; duplicate content deduplicates; equal-length divergent heads require explicit merge
lifecycle_rule: registration never proves installation, binding, provider interception, remediation or closure
closure_rule: PROVEN_CLOSED is rejected while any open requirement remains
history_rule: event history is append-only and may not regress
